card.name: Words just before error or risk terms
card.fires_on: Linking or partway words that come right before a word like error, overdose, or unnecessary procedures in warning text. It also fires on a few unrelated spots, such as the Spanish 'La' in 'La Haya'.

modes.label: Before medication-error wording
modes.description: Words in phrases about dosing or medication errors, just before the error word.
modes.example: Attention to these details may prevent some fosphenytoin sodium injection<< medication>> errors from occurring.

modes.label: Linking word before a harm outcome
modes.description: Small words like 'of' or 'in' that lead into a risk or overdose phrase.
modes.example: Such monitoring may increase the risk<< of>> unnecessary procedures, due to low test specificity

modes.label: Partway through a term
modes.description: Inside a longer word or a name list in a drug label.

card.plain: It fires on the words leading up to a mention of errors or harms in drug warnings.
